resources.string: Configure country, operator name and MCC/MNC separately for SIM 1 and SIM 2

Once the Hook is loaded, changes apply without rebooting the phone; reopen target apps to refresh cached data. May affect carrier-dependent services. SIM credentials, IP location and network registration remain unchanged. Disable the main or individual SIM switch to restore original values, and turn this feature off before disabling or uninstalling the module. The catalog includes private or shared codes, not every retail brand
